text: 27 predictions for 2026 🧵

1. Investors will push for clearer divisions between equity and tokens, but the issue won't be solved in 2026.

Several protocols will combine labs and foundations but it won't be the majority yet, although negative stigma will increase around dual structure projects.

2. Investor relations will become important.

Investors will demand standardized financials, disclosures, etc…

While IR will borrow aspects of traditional IR, it will be more social media and community first, and ultimately redefine standard practice in equities.

3. There will be a push for GAAP style accounting but we won’t get there in 2026.

We ultimately need regulation, most likely from CLARITY, to demand that.

We will see lightweight solutions that provide some standards from data providers.

4. The “revenue meta” discussions will evolve towards durability and quality.

Investors will stop giving credit to highly pro cyclical busineses, and for the first time enterprise software with highly sticky revenue will begin to become “sexy” within crypto.

5. DATs will largely do nothing. Several will make acquisitions around infrastructure (staking, yield generation, asset management, etc…) and attempt to transition into operating companies.

There will be rumblings about labs entities going public, but this won’t take off.

6. We'll see real pain in venture capital.

Unflattering performance will get reported in media outlets, many will struggle to raise and 2 blue chip funds will close.

Fintech VCs will enter and outcompete incumbents for attractive later stage deals.
7. VC investment will be anemic. Expect a slightly diminished figure from 2025’s $25B, $12-$18B.

8. Prediction markets will continue to succeed in 2026, but expect a turn in sentiment.

Legal challenges will ramp up and there will be negative press, despite that volume will continue to climb. Expect 2X from this year’s levels.

9. Kalshi and Polymarket will remain the champs in prediction markets.

Other CEXes will make inroads, Robinhood will continue to succed, Coinbase will fail.

No new startups will be successful, but some sports betting apps will.

10. Hyperliquid does fine, but growth slows.

Perps become incredibly competitive, new venues and incumbent CEXes like Coinbase will succeed at eating market share.

It will be a difficult year for the protocol and the community will face it's first real sentiment test.
11. Despite the loud fanfare, equity perps will have a slow start in 2026 but will do better on CEX venues than DEXes. Expect <5% of perp volume by EOY.

12. It will be a bad year for Bitcoin sentiment, driven by outperformance in gold, quantum fears, and an overhang from DATs.

Saylor’s reputation will take a hit, and Bitcoin’s weakness about “not being a productive asset” will gain steam again.

13. Quantum is a real threat, and it will get loud this year.

Bitcoin core devs will drag their feet, but ultimately come up with a workable solution.

By end of 2026 it will be somewhere between non-issue and “challenging but we see a light at the end of the tunnel.”

14. Ethereum will completely reverse sentiment and have its best year since 2021.

L1 will have a renaissance in 2026 and largely win the market for RWA issuance.

Stablecoin volume will grow slightly, more growth will come from treasuries and new types of RWAs.

15. RWA looping will become a big trend, but it won’t look like atomic asset looping.

Clever protocols will make use of offchain lenders and PBs who act as a bridge.

This will become a lucrative business line for PBs like Galaxy.

16. Onchain credit will become far more sophisticated in 2026.

VCs will launch credit funds (which largely won't work), but real credit funds will become more active.

They'll act as liquidators for RWAs and vault managers, 2-3 Apollo size funds will make big pushes in.

17. Vaults and onchain asset management become a big theme in 2026.

Vault AUM will grow but not an explosive amount from ~$5B today to $15-20B.

18. Morpho and Pendle are the big winners in DeFi.

Morpho because their simplified token structure and demonstrable lead in modular lending, Pendle because it’s the venue to achieve fixed rate lending (sc interest rate swaps).

19. Solana has a quiet but successful year.

Innovations like Alpenglow and ACE won’t pay dividends this year, but will succeed in attracting new DEXes and more activity.

REV will bottom around mid 2026, and start recovering into year end.

20. Passive liquidity provision in AMMs largely dies in 2026, first driven by the success of prop AMMs in Solana.

Solana will have a mini crisis around non-meme price discovery not happening on their chain, which will resolve by EOY

21. The new L1 trade is finally dead.

The network effects in Ethereum and Solana will become increasingly apparent, which will cause their REV multiple to get rerated (due to being perceived as sticky).

22. It’s another bad year for onchain infrastructure. Most general purpose L2s or alt L1s completely fail to attract any new users or apps.

Expect big pivots or changes in the business model from several large protocols by EOY.

23. Infrastructure will go through massive consolidation.

L2 frameworks, RaaS, shared sequencing, etc… all compress into one category.

These move from being thought of as ecosystems to CoSS, similar to Redhat.

2-3 vertically integrated solutions will emerge and do well.

24. Corporate chains are a big theme in 2026 with mixed results.

Tempo will debut to fanfare and strong initial metrics but slowly bleed, Arc will fail to gain adoption, Robinhood Chain will start on a similar trajectory to Base.

4-5 new chains will get announced, Blackrock is one of them.

25. Base will begin to come under some amount of scrutiny after having largely been assumed to win the L2 war in 2025.

The content coin push will fail, and there will be an existential crisis around not winning any category.

26. Privacy will begin to get introduced and pushed via the corporate chain layer.

The winning argument will come from financial institutions making a business case, not cypherpunk ideology.

Most existing solutions will not do well, ZEC was a one off and will have a bad 2026.

27. Agentic commerce within crypto will be just above a bagel on the year.

Expect almost no real volume or traction in crypto agentic commerce until better data, controls and provenance become widespread and in place.
